relations.description: The Ministers may jointly issue a statement setting out expectations for the specified agencies.
The statement must specify what the agencies must do to give effect to public service objectives related to Te Tiriti o Waitangi.
Before issuing the statement, the Ministers must consult Māori.
The statement must be issued to each specified agency and published in the Gazette.

extraction.summary: This provision outlines the process for the Ministers to jointly issue a statement setting expectations for various agencies regarding public service objectives related to Te Tiriti o Waitangi, with consultation requirements and publication obligations.

relations.description: The Minister must issue a tertiary education strategy.
The Minister may withdraw, replace, or amend a strategy.
The Minister must consult before issuing, withdrawing and replacing, or significantly amending the strategy.

A tertiary education strategy includes economic, social, environmental goals, and development aspirations of Māori and other population groups, as well as current and medium-term priorities for tertiary education.
An amendment to a strategy forms part of the amended strategy.

extraction.summary: The Minister must issue a tertiary education strategy that outlines long-term goals and priorities, which can be amended or replaced with consultation.
